$comment: Acceptance criteria verified by hand or outside the regular CI. scripts/check-ac-coverage.mjs counts them as covered.

criteria.how: Schema validation is automatic (test/contract/sarif-junit.test.ts); the upload with github/codeql-action/upload-sarif is checked by hand before the release.
Structure checked automatically; display in GitLab (artifacts:reports:junit) and Azure DevOps (PublishTestResults@2) checked by hand before the release, result in test/corpus/ci.md.

Before releasing create-playwright-security-scan: in a clean Playwright project (npm and pnpm) run npm init playwright-security-scan@next and pnpm create playwright-security-scan@next; the package lands in devDependencies and the wizard starts. Needs the published packages; the create script itself is tested in test/integration/create.test.ts.
Side-by-side screenshots of the perf and the security HTML report on the example project, light and dark theme, attached to the pull request of the report work package.
